_note: Hand-maintained, 2026-09-19. names: a name a source prints -> ISO3. codes: a source's own code -> ISO3, or null to ignore. ignore: names that are not ISO 3166-1 states, dropped on purpose and never reported as a failed join. Every entry was added after a real source printed that exact string, checked against site/vendor/iso-codes.json; the build fails on an alias whose target is not a real ISO3, and prints any alias no source used, because an alias nothing exercises is an untested guess.
_ignore_note: Only entries that are genuinely NOT in ISO 3166-1. Cook Islands (COK) and Niue (NIU) were wrongly listed here on 2026-09-19: both ARE ISO 3166-1 states, and ignoring them dropped their treaty rows, so their country cards read 'Not bound' for the CRC when the UN lists both as parties by accession (Cook Islands 6 Jun 1997, Niue 20 Dec 1995). That is a false legal claim about a real country, produced by an ignore list that looked tidy. Before adding anything here, check site/vendor/iso-codes.json for the name first.
